subject: bench: context injector — global summary generator
description:
Implement a global summary generator for the context-injection bench.

Goal: produce a compact paragraph (<=120 words) capturing current graph state — the 'compressed global branch' (NSA analogy) injected into subagent context at dispatch time.

Implement as /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/scripts/context-inject-global-summary.js:
- GET http://localhost:8787/api/graph?scope=frontier&compact=true
- Extract: task counts by status, top 3 ready task titles, top 3 recent done summaries
- Feed to one claude -p call (haiku, temp 0) → one paragraph
- Cache result in /tmp/context-inject-summary-cache.json with 60s TTL
- Export: async function getGlobalSummary() → string

No MCP, no orchestrator claims. Pure REST + claude CLI.
Self-test: node scripts/context-inject-global-summary.js --test prints paragraph + cache hit/miss.
